name: The Inside-Out Big Top
prompt: Suspend a red canvas valley between four tall corner poles. Acrobats tumble down its outward slopes into little catching hammocks. Spectators stand underneath and watch their silhouettes cross the luminous fabric like shadow puppets.

name: The Procession of Feet
prompt: Make a travelling circus out of five striped wooden shoes the size of houses. Each toe hinges open into a stage for a different balancing act. A trail of brass footprints stamps the route between them.

name: An Audience of Umbrellas
prompt: Build a circular acrobat's wire above a field of closely packed, upside-down parasols in faded plum and lemon. As the walker passes, spectators tilt the parasols in sequence to reflect the performer all around the ring.

name: The Quiet Giant
prompt: Lay a white wicker whale on its side, its widely spaced ribs making a tunnel. Little aerialists swing from vertebra to vertebra inside. A lone drummer at the tail keeps time for a cloud of silk fish.

name: Rehearsal for a Falling Moon
prompt: Set a great pitted silver sphere on a long inclined rail. Teams in russet costumes rehearse catching it with fans of taut ropes while a clown calmly measures the distance to the floor with a folding ruler.
